Notification No.NPSC/CESE-2012 dt. 19.11.2026 (CESE 2026 Second Shortlist) 
 Published on : 20-11-2026 09:38 am 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
 No. NPSC/CESE-2012 :: 
 Dated Kohima the 19 th November,
2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In continuation to the Notification vide NO.NPSC/EXAM-5/2022
dated 26 th October, 2026, on the basis of marks scored in the Written
Examination for CESE 2026 and Academic Weightage, the Commission hereby
shortlist the following candidates to have qualified for the Viva-voce who were not shortlisted due
to inadvertent omission at the time of scrutiny. 
 The
Interview schedule shall be as follows: 
 Sl.No 
 Date of Interview & Subjects 
 Roll No. 
 Reporting Time 
 Document verification date

 26E0601

 Political
 Science 
 26E2444 
 9:00 AM 
 23 /11/2026 
 Note:
 (a) 
 Selected candidates must produce all required documents
in ORIGINALS along with
attested/self-attested photo copies on the 23 . 11. 2026. 
 (b) 
 HSLC/Matriculation/Equivalent
Admit Card for proof of Date of Birth. No other Certificate will be accepted
for age proof. 
 (c) Mark
Sheets from HSLC/Equivalent onwards till requisite qualification. 
 (d) Pass
Certificate of HSLC, HSSLC, Degree, Post Graduate, NET, PhD, B.Ed, M.Ed, issued by Board/University. In the absence of
Degree Pass Certificate issued by University, candidates may submit Provisional
Pass Certificate issued by Institution/University. 
 (e) 
 For Persons with Benchmark Disability
(PwBD) candidates, certificate from competent medical authority must be
produced. 
 (f) 
 I.I., S.C./S.T.
& B.T. (if applicable) certificates. I.I., S.C./S.T. & B.T.
certificates should be signed only by District Authority not below the rank of
Additional Deputy Commissioner strictly as per latest formats. 
 (g) For
candidates who are Government Employees “NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE” should be
produced duly signed by the Head of the Department, with Name and Office Seal,
along with date of appointment. 
 (h) Interview
call letter can be downloaded from the Commission’s website at www.npsc.nagaland.gov.in 
21 st November,2026 noon
onwards. 
 (AKALA JAMIR) 
 Under Secretary 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
